what_happened: Re-verifying the dispatch's 2026-11-02 measurements found specs/CHANGE_LOG.md was caught up by a batched /todo run on 2026-11-04 (one day before this dispatch), reversing the staleness premise; also found the CHANGE_LOG reference count drifted from 3 to 5 files and that this repository's own ROADMAP.md carries no Maintenance section to fix. Re-verification changed the conclusion rather than just confirming it.

Found that scripts/dispatch-metrics.sh already joins git commits to dispatches via session_id (git log --grep), not via the task {N}: commit-message prefix, settling the design's hardest question (the commit-convention/renumbering tension) with existing evidence rather than a new mechanism. Also found five already-abandoned sibling proposals (carry_reason_on_dependency_edges and four others) corroborating the no-new-mechanism verdict.

Research Decision 5 specified adding a 'mandatory' top-level Decisions section to plan-format.md. Live check of validate-artifact.sh showed PLAN_SECTIONS drives a hard log_error on a missing required section, and no plan in the tree carries one -- promoting it would have failed every existing plan at gate-out. Plan narrowed it to the recognized-optional tier, mirroring the existing documentation-only SUMMARY_SECTIONS_OPTIONAL array, with the grounds recorded in the plan's Research Integration section.

Ran plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the draft plan as a dry run before returning. It emitted exactly the four declared source-store targets plus the __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel, confirming the dispatch's 'widen file_scope if the design requires agent-system edits' instruction is satisfied automatically at plan postflight -- no manual update-task-status.sh step needed (and --file-scope-add is restricted to postflight anyway).
